name: codebase-consistency-hooks
description: Harness-agnostic pattern-convergence checker (pure Python + git, zero dependencies). Flags where new or changed code diverges from the dominant convention already used elsewhere in the repo. Adapters for Claude Code (Stop + PostToolUse hooks), git pre-commit/pre-push, GitHub Actions (with SARIF upload), Cursor, and VS Code. All adapters call the same engine — adding a new harness means writing a new thin adapter, not reimplementing the analysis.
